contracts: One shared Workspace station authority; descriptors travel with host payloads and are checked before provider use
Transfers preserve identity, payload, descriptor, proportional rectangle, constraints, pin and visibility; destination z is window-local; both spaces validate before a move
Version 2 writes preserve floats/descriptors; version 1 loads remain readable; future/corrupt current never revives legacy files
Compatible live blueprints import once; invalid/unsupported legacy shapes refuse and whole-window save preflight restores former authorities
Measured Surface slots are the only body apertures; floated bodies and shared furniture interleave above tiled bodies via one retained frame texture
Explicit handle movement and Ctrl-docking; Alt move/resize and save; appearance/session/window-size capture refusals; no-op raise/rect changes do not save
Lens adapters install while hidden; each owns event delivery, activation snapshot, action queue, route table, namespace and replay
Window instance/session namespaces remap host references and selection; routes revalidate owner visibility, frame admission or provider generation/source
One producer mailbox with shared immutable retained nodes; each window keeps independent publication/mount/replay state
Repeated producer semantics choose focused or deterministic first appearance; departures detach before arrivals; retirement/navigation withdraw all mirrors
remaining_gates: Execute and review frame_stations, matching reopen, and isolated frame_lens_accessibility native fixtures; retain original A5 scenario intent/captures
Run native App workspace_stations and contributed_pane_arms regressions on capable hardware; their source is supplied but not executed locally
Physical CtrlF6/Tab/Escape/Alt/Ctrl-drag interactions across primary and multiple lenses; editor/media/scroll continuity
Real Narrator/VoiceOver/Orca/AT-SPI activation, focus, announcements and stale queued actions; queued fixture delivery is not OS proof
Repeated content appearances and ordered publication swaps; activation/deactivation during batches; close/reopen/profile/session changes
Lens native-engine pixels and body keyboard/input delivery, platform/optional-feature builds and full consumer tests
Authored/constrained float layout, shadows, narrow/DPI changes, drop-region/overlay previews, inline Component bodies and presented frame/performance acceptance
